name: @flowaid/node-sdk
description: The flowaid node SDK: defineNode/definePackage, toManifest (Zod → JSON NodeManifest), the capability-scoped ExecutionContext, NodeResult helpers and a test harness that runs nodes like the runtime does (CONTRACTS.ts §16, ARCHITECTURE.md §3). Browser-safe; depends only on @flowaid/workflow-core, @flowaid/shared and zod.
